title: Widget Links Now Work Across a Dealer Group
summary: A widget link opens the Sales Agent straight into a pre-qualification check, a booked visit or a text conversation. Dealer groups can now create them for every rooftop at once, limited to what all of them can honour.
body_markdown:
AI summary


A widget link opens the Sales Agent straight into a pre-qualification check, a booked visit or a text conversation. Dealer groups can now create them for every rooftop at once, limited to what all of them can honour.


A widget link opens the Sales Agent straight into one thing: a pre-qualification check, a booked visit, a text conversation. You create it in the Admin Portal, put it behind a button on your own site, and a visitor who clicks it lands mid-task instead of at an empty chat.


##


What changed


At a dealer group, nobody could create one. Every option sat disabled, because the group account holds the websites while each rooftop holds the things a link actually needs: its own visit times, its own texting setup. Someone working at group level can now create widget links for the whole group.


##


Only what every rooftop can honour


A group link offers the actions every active rooftop in the group can carry out. If one rooftop books visits and another does not, that option is not on the list. A visitor who clicks arrives at one rooftop, so a link is only worth offering when all of them can deliver it.


##


One link, not one per rooftop


A group-wide campaign, an email footer or a homepage button now needs a single link rather than a list of them, and the group keeps one standard for what its rooftops promise.


##


Where to find it


In the Admin Portal, open Settings, go to the Sales Agent's capabilities, and find Generated widget links.


## Frequently asked questions


Contact details, a pre-qualification check, a scheduled call, a booked visit, or a text conversation.


At least one active rooftop in the group cannot carry that action out. Turn it on for every rooftop and the option appears.
